newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Dena bank public offer oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: India's Dena bank public offer oversubscribed.

text.p: The state-run Dena Bank said its initial public offer of 1.8 billion rupees which opened on October 28 and closed on November 7 has been oversubscribed.

"As per the provisional figures received by registrars to the issue, the total subscription received so far has touched 2.0 billion rupees mark against the targeted 1.8 billion, and the full details are yet to be received," a bank release said.
The bank issued 60 million shares of 10 rupee face value at 30 rupees each to raise a total of 1.8 billion rupees.
It said contributions from the Indian public, expatriate Indians and employees through 78,000-odd applications constituted around 60 percent of the subscription.
The balance 40 percent was contributed by financial institutions and banks, it said.
The western Indian states of Gujarat and Maharashtra account for more than 70 percent of the bank's branch network.
